newsitem.title: UK: Berkeley up on 58 pct jump in H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Berkeley up on 58 pct jump in H1 profits.

text.p: Shares in British housebuilder and property developer Berkeley Group Plc rose sharply in pre-market trade on Tuesday after it announced a 58 percent jump in first- half profits.
By 0818 GMT the stock was up 20 pence, or 3.3 percent, at 631-1/2 pence. The group posted a jump in first half pre-tax profits to 30.1 million stg from a previous 19.0 million stg.
Berkeley chairman Graham Roper said demand for housing is firmer than in the last few years and was manifesting itself both in a higher volume of transactions and, in some locations, rising prices.
The dividend was raised to 2.5 pence per share from a previous 2.2 pence.
Other housebuilders also rose, with Barratt Developments up 3p at 241, Persimmon up 5p at 213 and Wilson Bowden up 2p at 451.
